raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Raw data contains 14 REVERSAL rows whose orig_txn_id points to original POSTED transactions. The silver filter keeps those originals and drops the reversal rows, so reversed transactions are counted and gold totals run high. Excluding POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL row should align the totals with settlement, though the reversal rule is inferred from the data and not confirmed by the source team.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
